articles.title: Meet the neon dragon: how our newest art style came together
paragraphs: Our new art direction began as a single paint-over on a Friday afternoon. Within a week the whole team was sketching glowing dragons, and the look quickly became the backbone of the next game's world. We kept the shapes bold, the colours saturated and the lighting dramatic, so that every frame works as a poster.
Next up: turning the concept into real-time characters without losing the painted feel.

articles.title: Night streets, real rain: building a city players want to get lost in
articles.alt: Character standing in a neon-lit city street
paragraphs: We built the street from reference photos of night markets, then spent weeks on wet surfaces, neon reflections and small details such as the cat by the shop window. The goal was a place that feels lived in, where players slow down just to look around.
